headline: Neueon Corporation Limited: NCLT approves reclassification of erstwhile promoter(s) under approved resolution plan
sum: NCLT order dated 23 October 2024 approved reclassification of erstwhile promoter(s) of Neueon Corporation Limited under the approved resolution plan, with NSE intimation on 25 June 2026 confirming compliance with SEBI Regulation 31A. The reclassification reflects the corporate debt resolution outcome and altered shareholding structure post-resolution.
detail: Neueon Corporation Limited, a company undergoing insolvency resolution, obtained NCLT approval on 23 October 2024 for reclassification of erstwhile promoter(s) under an approved resolution plan. The delay in NSE disclosure (intimation filed 25 June 2026) suggests either a recent trigger event or procedural compliance filing. Under SEBI Regulation 31A, any change in promoter classification requires immediate intimation to the exchange and disclosure of the new promoter's identity, shareholding pattern, and source of funds, subject to the resolution plan's commercial terms and NCLT order directions.
